rule: the crossword is the site map
title: Fjalëkryq
description: Thirty projects cross paths in one Albanian-inspired crossword. Read the clues, open the work, or solve it yourself.
signature: Typed letters fall into real intersecting answers with two Verlet bounces. A completed word flips in a wave and its clue becomes the project.
holdback: The board is cropped, so the whole site map is never visible at once; the only first-screen image is small.
